name: jdbc-sink-job-metrics-5m
notes: SINK connector -> analytics PostgreSQL job_metrics_5m (5-min windowed recruiter stats).
Insert mode UPSERT on PK (job_id, window_start, window_end): re-processing/at-least-once
delivery from ksqlDB does not inflate stored counts (idempotent sink).
pk.mode=record_value: the PRIMARY KEY is taken from value fields - the record key on this
topic is the ksql grouping key and would also work, but record_value keeps the mapping
explicit and independent of key serialization.
Value is Avro (Confluent wire format) written by ksqlDB; per-connector AvroConverter
override points at the Schema Registry (worker default stays JSON for CDC topics).
Sink-style DLQ: errors.deadletterqueue.* IS supported on sink connectors (it is NOT on
DLQ topic(s) must exist beforehand because broker auto.create=false: scripts/create_topics.ps1.
